title: Sideband join reaches the upstream with the client's protocol negotiation intact
note: The Frameless v3 join is GET /v1/live/{callId} and negotiates through openai-alpha: quicksilver=v2. The client requests no Sec-WebSocket-Protocol, so there is no subprotocol for the proxy to preserve.
provenance: Synthetic. Header names taken from the sideband upgrade codex-rs builds in codex-rs/core/src/realtime_conversation.rs; every value is invented for this fixture. No captured session, no account data, no request or response bodies.
